steps.title: List file names in the App Folder with list_folder
steps.detail: Call list_folder on a folder inside the App Folder with recursive set to false. If has_more is true, call list_folder/continue with the cursor. Expected response: an entries list with name fields. Fields: USER_ACCESS_TOKEN (from the authorization step), FOLDER_PATH_INSIDE_APP_FOLDER. Boundary check: confirm the response contains only metadata names and that the request log shows no download or upload calls.
steps.doneWhen: The response returns entries with names from the test account's App Folder and the request log shows only list_folder calls.
